speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are leaving out the critical part of my ask. I need the registry to update automatically the moment the weather feed lands, not just when the harness finishes running.
output.correction: That is not a scheduling preference, it is a data dependency. The model needs the latest weather signal before it can be trusted, so the trigger has to be the data arrival itself.
